candidats.description: Royal Mail Morris LDO 360cf van. Painted red with black wings and bumpers. Liveried 'ROYAL/MAIL' with crown and EIIR on both rear side panels. Slide opening driver and passengers doors and double outward opening rear doors. Inside rear has row of four bench-like seats on each side and semi-transparent ceiling. Separated from cab by sliding door with small grill. Single black upholstered PVC driver's seat and black upholstered PVC bench on passengers side. Roof level registration number plates at front and rear. Split windscreen with wipers fixed below. Round headlights and fog lights. Side mou
